faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Matsumoto Cloud Mining, Token Conversion, and On-Chain Payouts.
faq.q1: What is Matsumoto Mining and how does it work?
faq.a1: Matsumoto is a high-yield cloud reward simulation platform on BNB Smart Chain. You register for free, tap 'Mine' once every 24 hours, and your cloud terminal accrues Matsumoto Points. There is zero hardware wear and zero electricity cost.
faq.q2: How does the token conversion to $Matsumoto work?
faq.a2: All accrued internal points convert at a fixed 3:1 ratio (3 Points = 1 $Matsumoto BEP-20 token). When you withdraw, $Matsumoto tokens are transferred directly to your connected BNB Chain address.
faq.q3: Can I stack multiple booster packages?
faq.a3: Yes! Cloud booster packages are fully stackable. You can activate multiple $1, $5, $10, or $50 booster rigs simultaneously to achieve massive hourly hashrates.
faq.q4: How does the referral multiplier work?
faq.a4: As you invite new miners with your personal referral link, your tier increases from Level 1 (×1) up to Level 6 (×8). This multiplier scales your effective mining accrual dramatically.
faq.q5: What are the requirements for withdrawing?
faq.a5: To withdraw: 1) You need at least 100 points, 2) Complete basic KYC verification to prove unique identity, and 3) Maintain a 7-day cadence between withdrawal requests.
